notes: All-Orcs batch: surface ran as four fresh gpt-6-sol lanes of 20. Every lane echoed its identities exactly and read only its own envelope and the contract.
The contextual run (15 entries) read only its own envelope and the contract. The host scanned its native log before harvest.

Implementation-backed: the flying grapple pulls foes toward the target's tile, so a collision with the target itself also deals damage; Arcane Cloth is a store; the structural weakness is a tower floor tile. Format fixes are limited to line breaks and tabs; the space-only lines of the Destructicus ending are not restored, to keep the whitespace gate clean.
Orcs public source file SHA matched this batch workset; source repository and commit remain unpinned.
9 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 39 backlog from 8 to 17; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
